title: array indexing, size and slicing
purpose: Observe type, generic and collection semantics.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.9/6.6: zero-based indexing, end-exclusive slice, empty slice at the end. language owner decision, 21.10.2026 (D-046): different numeric categories interact only after an explicit cast; no implicit promotion, so a byte index is converted with .int().
